mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT pp.PORTFOLIO_ID id, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME text
FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO pp LEFT JOIN PTL_SEC_ACCT psa on pp.PORTFOLIO_ID = psa.PORTFOLIO_ID left join PTL_CAPACCT_INFO pci on pci.PORTFOLIO_ID=pp.PORTFOLIO_ID and pci.ACCT_TYPE = 'A01' and pci.ACCT_TYPE = 'A01'
pp.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y' AND pp.PORTFOLIO_TYPE != '04'
AND pp.PORTFOLIO_ID != #{transferPortfolioId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND (pp.PORTFOLIO_ID in (select PORTFOLIO_ID from PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY where USER_ID = #{userId}) OR pp.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID in (select PORTFOLIO_ID from PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY where USER_ID = #{userId}))
AND (pp.PORTFOLIO_ID LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') OR pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%'))
AND psa.ACCT_NO = #{acctNo}
and pp.mdate > to_date(#{tradeDate},'yyyy-mm-dd')

with maxdate as ( select MAX(t.EFF_DATE) EFF_DATE,t.CASH_ID from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE t where t.EFF_DATE <=to_date(#{tradeDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') group by t.CASH_ID) select fccr.EFF_DATE, fccr.BASIS, fccr.YIELD, fcp.VDATE from FIN_CASH_PLAN fcp, FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE fccr inner join maxdate on maxdate.CASH_ID = fccr.CASH_ID and maxdate.EFF_DATE = fccr.EFF_DATE where fcp.CASH_ID = fccr.CASH_ID and fcp.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and fcp.VDATE <= to_date(#{tradeDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') and ((fcp.CASH_TYPE = '01' and fcp.mdate > to_date(#{tradeDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')) or (fcp.CASH_TYPE = '04' and fcp.mdate >= to_date(#{tradeDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')))

SELECT AD.PROD_REGIST_CODE FROM FIN_PRODUCT FIN LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD AD ON FIN.FINPROD_ID = AD.FINPROD_ID
FIN.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{portfolioId} AND FIN.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2}
